name: Apache Spark
desc: Unified engine for large-scale data processing.

resources.name: KeystoneML
resources.desc: Type safe machine learning pipelines with RDDs.

resources.name: Learning Spark, 2nd Edition
resources.desc: Introduction to Spark API with Spark 3.0 covered. Good source of knowledge about basic concepts.

resources.name: Advanced Analytics with Spark
resources.desc: Useful collection of Spark processing patterns. Accompanying GitHub repository: sryza/aas.

resources.name: Mastering Apache Spark
resources.desc: Interesting compilation of notes by Jacek Laskowski. Focused on different aspects of Spark internals.

resources.name: Spark in Action
resources.desc: New book in the Manning's "in action" family with +400 pages. Starts gently, step-by-step and covers large number of topics. Free excerpt on how to setup Eclipse for Spark application development and how to bootstrap a new application using the provided Maven Archetype. You can find the accompanying GitHub repo here.

resources.name: Large-Scale Intelligent Microservices
resources.desc: Microsoft paper that presents an Apache Spark-based micro-service orchestration framework that extends database operations to include web service primitives.

resources.name: Resilient Distributed Datasets: A Fault-Tolerant Abstraction for In-Memory Cluster Computing
resources.desc: Paper introducing a core distributed memory abstraction.

resources.name: Spark SQL: Relational Data Processing in Spark
resources.desc: Paper introducing relational underpinnings, code generation and Catalyst optimizer.

resources.name: Structured Streaming: A Declarative API for Real-Time Applications in Apache Spark
resources.desc: Structured Streaming is a new high-level streaming API, it is a declarative API based on automatically incrementalizing a static relational query.

resources.name: Data Science and Engineering with Apache Spark (edX XSeries)
resources.desc: Series of five courses (Introduction to Apache Spark, Distributed Machine Learning with Apache Spark, Big Data Analysis with Apache Spark, Advanced Apache Spark for Data Science and Data Engineering, Advanced Distributed Machine Learning with Apache Spark) covering different aspects of software engineering and data science. Python oriented.

resources.name: Big Data Analysis with Scala and Spark (Coursera)
resources.desc: Scala oriented introductory course. Part of Functional Programming in Scala Specialization.

resources.name: AMP Camp
resources.desc: Periodical training event organized by the UC Berkeley AMPLab. A source of useful exercise and recorded workshops covering different tools from the Berkeley Data Analytics Stack.

resources.name: Oryx 2
resources.desc: Lambda architecture platform built on Apache Spark and Apache Kafka with specialization for real-time large scale machine learning.

resources.name: Photon ML
resources.desc: A machine learning library supporting classical Generalized Mixed Model and Generalized Additive Mixed Effect Model.

resources.name: PredictionIO
resources.desc: Machine Learning server for developers and data scientists to build and deploy predictive applications in a fraction of the time.

resources.name: Crossdata
resources.desc: Data integration platform with extended DataSource API and multi-user environment.
